name: helper-army-pace
description: The helper saves for its faction's main battle unit. A Foundry player with the helper on (army 24, scouting) against a very easy Foundry turtle on Desert Expanse, whose first attack comes at 12:00, so nothing interrupts the build-up. The helper must make tanks at a steady pace instead of the hover skimmers the bank covers first, and auto-expand must keep building. The power plant needs iron 20 with the keep and the tank 15; auto-expand builds its first plant when the grid runs short, in runs of seeds 3, 5 and 7 from 6:38 to 9:41 on main and from 4:06 to 8:31 with this change. A Foundry helper does not scout here: its scout is the drone, which needs an aircraft factory. Run seeds 3, 5 and 7.
